# third_party

## ftl_structs_elf64.h

IDA-exported C struct dump of FTL: Faster Than Light (Linux amd64 build), taken from the
FTL-Hyperspace project (`libzhlgen/test/functions/ELF_amd64/FTLGameStripped.h`),
licensed GPL-3.0-or-later. It is **layout-only**: used to compute offsets/sizes of game
objects read from the running process. No functions are implemented.

Check: `g++ -std=c++17 -fsyntax-only -w -x c++ native/third_party/ftl_structs_elf64.h`

### Edits (layout-preserving; no field added, removed, renamed or retyped)
- Prelude: forward declarations of all structs, `#define __thiscall`, `#define __stdcall`,
  `Package*` typedefs, `#include <string>/<vector>/<map>`, `typedef uint8_t _BYTE`,
  `typedef int SDLKey / TouchAction / SoundFormat` (4-byte enums).
- `Type *this` parameters in `VTable_*` function pointers renamed to `*self`.
- 6 struct definitions moved earlier (bodies unchanged) so by-value members are complete.
- Alias `std__unordered_map_27std__string___ResourceEvent` ->
  `std__unordered_map_26std_string___ResourceEvent` (name typo in export; both opaque 0x30).
- `STEAM1613OPTIONSSCREENADDITIONS_TYPE/_NAME` macros defined as a zero-length char array
  (assumed absent on Linux; unverified).

### Caveats
- `std__string` in this dump is 8 bytes (old COW libstdc++ ABI, matches the game), but a few
  members (CrewDesc, LoadInfo, `StarMap::locations_grid`) use host
  `std::string` / `std::map`, whose size depends on the host libstdc++.

`OFFSETS.txt` is generated by `native/tools/offsets_probe.cpp`.
